subject: MAP kickoff & decision gates — draft, owners, and dependency checklist
messages:
From: Soojin Lee <soojin.lee@redwood.com>
To: Claire Turner <claire.turner@healthbridge.com>
Cc: Eric Liu <eric.liu@healthbridge.com>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 28 May 2027 14:03:00 -0000
Subject: MAP kickoff & decision gates — draft, owners, and dependency checklist

Hi Claire —

Thanks again for the time today — good conversation and helpful context on your pilot objectives. As promised, I attached an initial Mutual Action Plan (MAP) draft to get us aligned on milestones, proposed owners, dependencies, and a couple of target close windows. High level summary below and a few asks to keep momentum:

Proposed milestones (draft):
- M1: Pilot configuration & infra readiness (owner: HealthBridge infra + Redwood Delivery) — estimated 2 weeks after kickoff
- M2: Pilot run & evaluation (owner: HealthBridge product + Redwood CSM) — 2 weeks
- M3: Integration hardening & roll decision (owner: HealthBridge Eng lead)
- M4: Production enablement & SLA onboarding (owner: HealthBridge ops + Redwood Dedicated team)

Target close windows (pick one):
- Option A: July 30, 2027 (aggressive — requires procurement signoff by 7/2)
- Option B: Aug 20, 2027 (more conservative — accommodates procurement and security review)

Key dependencies we flagged on the call:
- Procurement timeline / PO issuance
- Security questionnaire (SaaS + data residency clarifications)
- Access to staging dataset and test credentials

Asks: 
1) Please confirm the primary stakeholders who will own each milestone (I’ve suggested owners in the attached MAP-draft-v1.pdf).
2) Which target close window do you prefer (Option A or B)?
3) Any additional dependencies we missed?

I’ve cc'd Rishi (our security lead) and Eric for visibility. Once we’ve got stakeholder confirmation I’ll loop in Grace (CSM) to own onboarding milestones and put a short playbook together for the kickoff.

Attachment: MAP-draft-v1.pdf (outline + timeline options)

Thanks — looking forward to locking this in.

Best,
Soojin Lee
Enterprise Account Executive
Redwood Inference
soojin.lee@redwood.com | +1 (415) 555-0192

From: Claire Turner <claire.turner@healthbridge.com>
To: Soojin Lee <soojin.lee@redwood.com>
Cc: Eric Liu <eric.liu@healthbridge.com>
Date: Fri, 28 May 2027 15:12:00 -0000
Subject: Re: MAP kickoff & decision gates — draft, owners, and dependency checklist

Thanks, Soojin — great write-up. A few quick confirmations from our side: 

Stakeholder confirmations (owners):
- Pilot configuration & infra readiness: Eric Liu (CTO) / Infrastructure team
- Pilot run & evaluation: Claire Turner (Director, Product)
- Integration hardening: Naveen Kapoor (Eng Manager)
- Production enablement: Olivia Chen (Head of Ops)

Procurement: Please include our procurement lead (procurement@healthbridge.com) on the next communications — they’ve requested a draft SOW and estimated spend before initiating the PO.

Regarding target close: can we move to Option B (Aug 20)? Procurement cycles and our internal security reviews are likely to push timelines out. If there’s a way to shorten any of the security gating steps (e.g., a focused scope for pilot data), we’re open to it.

I attached a short procurement timeline we use internally — it shows why early July is tight for us.

On dependencies: please add a short checklist for the security review items we discussed (SOC 2 evidence, data retention policy, encryption in transit).

Thanks — I’ll wait for the updated MAP and a kickoff date suggestion.

—Claire
Claire Turner
Director, Product
HealthBridge
claire.turner@healthbridge.com | +1 (610) 555-2121

Grace — looping you in to take ownership of the onboarding and pilot-run milestones. Specific asks for CSM:
- Build the pilot playbook (detailed runbook for M2) and share a dry-run checklist
- Coordinate test credential provisioning with HealthBridge infra

Thanks all — next steps:

2) Rishi to flag any blockers by Jun 7
3) HealthBridge to confirm procurement contact and PO timing
